items.title: mcpx: one script-resolution rule for CLI and daemon — /v1/exec resolves names (#2168)
items.body:
Closes #2168.

Revival of PR #2586 (closed unmerged) onto current main — task 14339, follow-on of triage task 7863, which verified the issue still live at main and scoped this fix path.

## What
- resolveScript logic moves to the new shared package internal/scriptresolve, used by both the CLI (internal/cli) and the daemon path (internal/execsvc + internal/daemon /v1/exec) — no forked copies.
- POST /v1/exec with a bare file name (e.g. "report") now resolves it on the daemon's search path; a miss errors naming every directory searched.
- CLI --remote default unchanged (resolve locally, send text); new --remote-file form asks the daemon to resolve.
- docs/exec.md documents the --remote-file form.
- The #1919 paths.scripts scope question: answered — the daemon reads the same paths.scripts setting as the CLI (no daemon-specific list); recorded in code comments in routes_exec.go / execsvc.go.

## Revival fixes vs the #2586 branch
- Module path updated: github.com/dezren39/mcpx -> github.com/developing-today/code/pkgs/mcpx.
- Cherry-pick conflicts merged with current main's newer work: CLI dryRun flag and daemon ConfigDir/Calls (from the #2611 review) kept alongside remoteFile/Scripts.
- Bug fix: the old branch's scriptresolve.Extensions dropped .py, silently breaking name resolution for Python scripts — restored to .ts, .mts, .js, .mjs, .py. A plausible cause of the basic:test failure that blocked #2586.

## Verification (laptop, this branch @ aec0f64d4d)
- go build ./... — pass.
- go test ./... in pkgs/mcpx — all 51 packages pass, including new daemon-resolution tests in internal/scriptresolve and internal/execsvc mirroring the CLI resolveScript tests.

Oracle: the acceptance criteria on #2168, plus pre-existing CLI resolution behavior (extension order incl. .py last) preserved by the shared list.

items.title: chore(nix): bump opencode pin to ff9858ae — codex sync instance-door fix (#7991)
items.body: ## What Bumps the `opencode` flake input pin in `flake.lock`: - `620602138c659820e7080db40410cebff6dc707f` → `ff9858aed519cd733333fc6f889f45fddfb4d4fa` Done via `nix flake lock --override-input opencode github:developing-today-forks/opencode/ff9858aed519cd733333fc6f889f45fddfb4d4fa`; the lock diff is exactly the opencode node's `rev`/`narHash`/`lastModified` (3 lines). ## Why `ff9858ae` is the merge commit of [opencode#2237](https://github.com/developing-today-forks/opencode/pull/2237) — the durable fix for #7991: `CodexSync` listed credentials only under the base `openai` integration and silently reported no-credential, while the deployed config keeps the ChatGPT credentials on instance doors (`openai.main`, `openai.alternate`). The stored `openai.main` token froze and expired 2026-11-09, killing workhorse session starts with "Provided authentication token is expired". The fix selects the sync target by the auth file's account ID across the base integration and its instance doors. #7991 is currently closed on a hand-applied sync of the credential row; that token expires **2026-11-19T02:49Z**. This pin bump is the deploy chain that makes the cure permanent before then. ## Also carried (fork main since the old pin) All already merged on the fork's main: the failure-bench cap (#2216, fork #2212), session-expired URL scoping (#2180), Muse inference key preference (#2161), patch-anchor fix (#2168), antigravity convertSchema fix (#2236), bundled models.dev snapshot refresh, and the #1677/#1678/#1679/#1680 facade design docs. Refs #7991. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: mcpx: register --remote-file in exec-flag coverage contract + regenerate flag index (follow-up to #8019)
items.body: Follow-up to PR #8019 (#2168), from lane code-w task 14339's post-merge re-verification. ## Problem The merged --remote-file flag was never registered in the exec-flag coverage contract (#2188), so two internal/cli guards fail on current main: - TestExecFlagSetIsFullyProbed: exec --remote-file and run --remote-file are hand-written flags with no probe row and no exemption. - TestHandFlagIndexIsCurrent: flagindex_generated.go is stale (missing the new flag). ## Fix - execflagcoverage.go: reasoned exemption for remote-file. The probe guard's rows pass inline source, which --remote-file refuses by design, so a with/without inline row can observe only the refusal, never the daemon-side resolution. The resolution itself is covered in internal/scriptresolve, internal/execsvc (resolve_test.go), and internal/daemon. - flagindex_generated.go: regenerated via go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestHandFlagIndexIsCurrent -update (+2 lines: exec/run remote-file). ## Verification (laptop, this branch; logs read back from disk) - go build ./... — pass. - go test ./internal/cli/ — ok (28.4s), both guards pass. - go test ./internal/e2e/ -run TestExecFlagProbeRowsMatchCoverage — ok. - Adjacent packages re-checked on the #8019 head: internal/scriptresolve ok, internal/execsvc ok, internal/daemon ok. - internal/settings has 5 failing tests that fail identically on clean main (verified at afeccac879) — pre-existing, tracked on #2716, untouched here. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added the `--remote-file` option to `exec` and `run`, allowing a script name to be resolved using the remote daemon’s script search path.
